preconditions.description: Attacker must be the owner of the MasterChef contract 0x2f619a1270226fD8ed3Df82f0C1e0cd90804346d.

exploit_hint: The contract owner can exploit their privileges by adding a new liquidity pool with a disproportionately high allocation point. First, the attacker, who is the owner, should create a new, worthless BEP20 token. Then, they call the `add(allocPoint, lpToken, withUpdate)` function on the MasterChef contract, passing in the address of their worthless token as `lpToken` and a very large number for `allocPoint`. This action will cause the majority of the reward tokens to be allocated to the new pool, which the attacker exclusively controls, thereby siphoning rewards away from legitimate stakers.
